multi_entity_note: Two parties (SAGEM S.A. Departement MORPHO Systemes and XIMAGE corporation) with two addresses; Kuwait Government is the end customer.
processing_note: MORPHO shall pay all charges under this Agreement,      including the total Annual Maintenance Charge, within thirty (30) days      after receipt of a valid invoice from XIMAGE.

contract.document_name.rationale: The cover title is Maintenance Agreement, and the Program definition refers to it by that name; 'This Agreement' is only a generic reference.

contract.agreement_date.rationale: The agreement is entered into this 31 January, 1994 and the signature line repeats that date; December 10, 1993 is the Effective Date.

contract.effective_date.rationale: EFFECTIVE DATE is defined as the installation date, i.e. December 10, 1993; the Section 2 mention is only the defined term.

contract.expiration_date.rationale: The initial term runs at least one year from the Effective Date; no expiry date is stated as a date.

contract.governing_law.rationale: No governing-law clause; Washington State is only the arbitration seat and other mentions are addresses or tax jurisdiction.

contract.renewal_term.rationale: Section 2: the agreement automatically renews for consecutive one (1) year terms.

contract.notice_period.rationale: Section 2: renewal occurs unless either party gives at least sixty (60) days prior written notice of non-renewal.
